filesChanged.reason: Root-cause fix for cost-consistency: the legacy GET /api/analytics/usage and GET /api/analytics/costs endpoints summed raw tu.cost_usd (often 0 when only token counts are recorded) for total_cost_usd, while input_cost_usd/output_cost_usd were already derived from model_pricing. This contradicted the documented contract (analytics.ts:508 'Uses model_pricing table for actual provider rates') and disagreed with the FinOps dashboard/accounting engine. Replaced the raw sum with a pricing-derived CASE expression (input_tokens/1e6 * input_cost_per_1m + output_tokens/1e6 * output_cost_per_1m, with _1k fallbacks) via LEFT JOIN model_pricing, falling back to raw cost_usd only for unpriced models. Also fixed the /costs spec breakdown ordering to ORDER BY MAX(tu.recorded_at) DESC LIMIT 20 (bounded, recency-ordered) to match the breakdown contract. 73 insertions, 7 deletions.

backendFinOpsTests.note: Includes the 3 analytics-cost-consistency tests that the analytics.ts fix resolved (usage totals derive cost from pricing when raw cost_usd is zero; /costs spec breakdown returns last 20 newest-first; workspace-scoped rorca breakdown ordering).
